profile.org_note: Family-owned. Since 2026 The Fischer Group has been the holding company over Fischer Homes (homebuilding), Grand Communities LLC (the in-house land developer: entitlement, infrastructure, finished lots), Acendion Collective (multifamily and mixed-use, raises private investor capital), Victory Mortgage and Homestead Title. Group officers (Chairman Greg Fischer, CEO Tim McMahon, CFO Chris Murphy) sit at The Fischer Group. Fischer Homes has a President (Jason Finch, from Sept 2026) and a COO (Jay Smith), then region presidents (South Region confirmed; seat open since Finch's promotion) and market presidents in 11 markets. Land is split between a corporate land-development arm (Grand Communities, led on entitlements by VP Jason Wisneiwski) and land acquisition managers or VPs in each market (Atlanta has its own VP of Land Acquisition). The Chairman's stated focus is land development and banking relationships, and the CFO owns capital planning. The company's land-acquisition line is (859) 344-2702 (Sell My Land page). An open VP of Land Acquisition job for a new Knoxville, TN market (posted March 2026) asks the hire to find other ways to finance land purchases.
profile.summary: Private, family-owned builder ranked about 31st to 32nd in the US (2,991 closings and about $1.45B revenue in the 2026 rankings), with about 800 associates and 200+ communities in 11 markets across KY, OH, IN, GA, MO, FL and NC. It develops much of its own land through its affiliate Grand Communities, but it is still adding markets (Raleigh and Lexington in 2026, and a Knoxville land search under way). Its job ad for the Knoxville land head names 'alternate forms of financing' for land purchases as part of the role, which is an opening for a land banker in new markets with no legacy land pipeline.
